Grooming & care

All the classics, done with patience

We groom dogs of every size and coat, and cats too. Each visit is tailored to the coat, the character and what you want.

Bath & spa

Lukewarm water, shampoo for the coat type, a little massage and conditioner when needed.

Haircut

With scissors or clippers — breed cut, summer cut or simply tidy, as you prefer.

Cats

Gentle brushing, mat removal, nail trims and a bath when needed — at a quiet hour.

Drying & brushing

Warm air and a thorough brush-out, so the coat stays light, shiny and tangle-free.

Nails & paws

Careful nail trims, tidy fur between the pads and a little care for the paws.

Ears & hygiene

Gentle ear cleaning, eyes and hygiene areas — the small things that make a big difference.

How it works

One grooming visit, step by step

01
  1. 01

    Hello & a look at the coat

    It sniffs the place, gets a treat, and we check coat, skin and nails together with you. We agree what will be done — and the price — before we start.

  2. 02

    Bath with lukewarm water

    Shampoo chosen for the coat and skin, a calm massage, careful rinsing so nothing stays behind.

  3. 03

    Drying & brushing

    Warm — never hot — air, while we brush out loose hair and small tangles.

  4. 04

    Haircut & finish

    Scissors and clippers for the style you asked for: face, paws and tail tidied with care.

  5. 05

    Nails, ears, a little scent

    The small finishing touches: nails, ears, eyes — and a light pet-safe scent if you like.

  6. 06

    Pick-up with a smile

    We let you know when it is ready and tell you how the visit went.

Spa

A little quiet, a little lavender

The spa package adds a coat mask, a longer massage during the bath and paw care — for dogs who deserve a day off.

    Questions

    Good to know

    At a glance

    • Pet shop & grooming salon for dogs and cats
    • 25is Martiou 140, Petroupoli 132 31
    • Grooming & spa by appointment
    • Pet shop: no appointment needed
    Do I need an appointment for grooming?
    Yes — grooming and spa are by appointment, so every pet gets its own unhurried time. For the pet shop no appointment is needed — just drop in.
    How much does a bath or a haircut cost?
    It depends on size, coat type and condition (e.g. mats). We tell you the price before we start, so there are no surprises.
    How long does it take?
    It depends on the pet and the package. When you book we tell you roughly when to come back for pick-up.
    My dog is nervous. What do you do?
    We go at its pace: time to sniff around, breaks when needed and gentle handling. Tell us beforehand anything you know about its character.
    Do you groom cats too?
    Yes. For cats we offer gentle brushing, mat removal, nail trims and a bath when needed, at a quiet time of day.
    When can a puppy come for the first time?
    Once its basic vaccinations are complete, as your vet advises. The first visit is short and gentle, so it learns this is a nice place.
    What can I find in the pet shop?
    Dog and cat food, treats, toys, beds, leashes and collars, bowls and grooming products. Looking for something specific? Just ask.
    Where are you?
    At 25is Martiou 140, Petroupoli (postcode 132 31), Athens.
